# Brivellis

> Brivellis publishes free, editable templates, free video courses, self-assessment tools and practical articles for IT service management, cybersecurity and compliance, business resilience, and governance and risk. Every kit includes a worked example for each template. No sign-up is needed for any download.

Brivellis Technologies FZE LLC is an independent company. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or licensed by ISO, IEC, NIST or PeopleCert. Standards are referenced by their designation and described in our own words; they are not reproduced. ITIL® is a registered trade mark of the PeopleCert group. The material is templates and education, not audit, certification or legal advice.

## Domains

- [IT Service Management](https://brivellis.com/domains/it-service-management/): Running IT services well, from ITIL® practices to an ISO/IEC 20000-1 service management system.
- [Cybersecurity & Compliance](https://brivellis.com/domains/cybersecurity-compliance/): Building and evidencing a security programme that auditors and regulators can follow.
- [Business Resilience](https://brivellis.com/domains/business-resilience/): Keeping critical services running through disruption, from impact analysis to recovery.
- [Governance & Risk](https://brivellis.com/domains/governance-risk/): How organisations decide, prioritise and stay in control as technology changes.

## Free kits

- [SMS Starter Kit for ISO/IEC 20000-1](https://brivellis.com/resources/iso-20000-starter-kit/): 17 editable files, with a worked example for every template, for a service management system.
- [Cybersecurity Awareness Programme Kit](https://brivellis.com/resources/cybersecurity-awareness-kit/): 11 free, editable files for a planned security awareness programme, with the five pieces of evidence auditors ask for.
- [BCMS Starter Kit for ISO 22301](https://brivellis.com/resources/bcms-starter-kit-iso-22301/): 14 free, editable files for an ISO 22301 BCMS, from business impact analysis to tested plans, with RTO and RPO checks built in.
- [ISMS Starter Kit for ISO/IEC 27001:2022](https://brivellis.com/resources/isms-starter-kit-iso-27001/): 13 free, editable files for an ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS, from scope to management review, with a 93-control SoA and a NIST CSF 2.0 crosswalk.
- [AIMS Starter Kit for ISO/IEC 42001:2023](https://brivellis.com/resources/aims-starter-kit-iso-42001/): 16 free, editable files for an ISO/IEC 42001:2023 AIMS, from AI system inventory to management review, with an impact assessment and a 38-control SoA.

## Free templates

- [Acceptable Use Policy](https://github.com/brivellis/free-templates/releases/download/aup-v1.0/Brivellis_Acceptable_Use_Policy_Template_v1.0.docx): One editable Word policy for devices, email, cloud, remote work and AI assistants, with a signed acknowledgement form.
- [ISO/IEC 20000-1 readiness checklist](https://github.com/brivellis/free-templates/releases/download/checklists-v1.0/Brivellis_Readiness_Checklist_ISO20000-1_v1.0.xlsx): One Excel workbook to check your service management system against clauses 4 to 10, with evidence, owner and a % ready heat map.
- [ISO/IEC 27001 readiness checklist](https://github.com/brivellis/free-templates/releases/download/checklists-v1.0/Brivellis_Readiness_Checklist_ISO27001-2022_v1.0.xlsx): Clauses 4 to 10 and all 93 Annex A controls in one Excel workbook, with the evidence auditors ask for and a % ready heat map.
- [ISO 22301 readiness checklist](https://github.com/brivellis/free-templates/releases/download/checklists-v1.0/Brivellis_Readiness_Checklist_ISO22301_v1.0.xlsx): Check your business continuity management system against clauses 4 to 10 in one Excel workbook, with evidence and a % ready heat map.
- [NIST CSF 2.0 readiness checklist](https://github.com/brivellis/free-templates/releases/download/checklists-v1.0/Brivellis_Readiness_Checklist_NIST-CSF-2.0_v1.0.xlsx): All 106 NIST CSF 2.0 outcomes in one Excel workbook, with status, maturity, evidence and a % ready heat map.
- [ISO/IEC 42001 readiness checklist](https://github.com/brivellis/free-templates/releases/download/checklists-v1.0/Brivellis_Readiness_Checklist_ISO42001-2023_v1.0.xlsx): Clauses 4 to 10 and all 38 Annex A controls in one Excel workbook, with status, maturity, evidence and a % ready heat map.

## Free courses

- [SMS in Practice: Implementing ISO/IEC 20000-1 (Free Course)](https://brivellis.com/courses/sms/#watch): A free video course that walks through the kit, template by template.
- [ISMS in Practice: Implementing ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (Free Course)](https://brivellis.com/courses/isms/#watch): A free video course that walks through the ISMS kit, template by template.
- [BCMS in Practice: Implementing ISO 22301 with AI (Free Course)](https://brivellis.com/courses/bcms/#watch): A free video course that walks through the BCMS kit, template by template.

## Free tools

- [Technology Readiness Check](https://brivellis.com/resources/readiness-assessment/): Assess strategic alignment, foundations, governance, delivery, skills, and measurement.
- [Initiative Prioritizer](https://brivellis.com/resources/initiative-prioritizer/): Compare three technology initiatives using value, urgency, confidence, effort, and risk.
- [Your CPD record](https://brivellis.com/resources/cpd-record/): Play the free course lessons on brivellis.com and save the ones you complete as your own CPD record (PDF).

## Guides

- [From Vision to Value](https://brivellis.com/downloads/brivellis-from-vision-to-value.pdf): A practical framework for connecting technology ambition, delivery, governance, and measurable outcomes.
- [Seven Decisions Before Scaling AI](https://brivellis.com/downloads/brivellis-seven-decisions-before-scaling-ai.pdf): An executive guide to ownership, value, data, risk, operating model, adoption, and measurement.
- [Operational Resilience Leadership Playbook](https://brivellis.com/downloads/brivellis-operational-resilience-playbook.pdf): A structured approach to critical services, dependencies, scenarios, recovery, and continuous learning.

## Open GRC Index

> A free, sourced index of open GRC resources, alphabetical and never ranked. Entries marked House are made by Brivellis. Full data (CC BY 4.0): https://brivellis.com/open-grc-index/index.json

- [Acceptable Use Policy template](https://brivellis.com/open-grc-index/acceptable-use-policy-template/) (House): Free template or kit. Editable acceptable use policy for staff use of IT and information, with an annex that maps sections to ISO/IEC 27001 control numbers.
- [AIMS Starter Kit for ISO/IEC 42001:2023](https://brivellis.com/open-grc-index/aims-starter-kit-iso42001/) (House): Free template or kit. Starter document set for an AI management system, with an AI system inventory, risk and impact templates, and a completed example for a fictional company.
- [BCMS in Practice (free course)](https://brivellis.com/open-grc-index/bcms-in-practice-course/) (House): Free course. 27 short lessons that build a business continuity management system with the BCMS Starter Kit and a fictional company.
- [BCMS Starter Kit for ISO 22301:2019](https://brivellis.com/open-grc-index/bcms-starter-kit-iso22301/) (House): Free template or kit. Starter document set for a business continuity management system, including an impact analysis workbook and a worked example for a fictional company.
- [CISO Assistant Community Edition](https://brivellis.com/open-grc-index/ciso-assistant-community/): Open-source tool. Self-hosted GRC platform with a large built-in library of frameworks, covering risk assessment, audits, applicability and evidence.
- [Comp AI Community Edition](https://brivellis.com/open-grc-index/comp-ai-community/): Open-source tool. Self-hosted compliance platform for evidence collection, policy management and control implementation, covering ISO/IEC 27001 among other frameworks.
- [Compliance Trestle](https://brivellis.com/open-grc-index/compliance-trestle/): Open-source tool. Command-line tool for managing compliance content as code in the OSCAL formats: catalogues, profiles, component definitions and assessments.
- [Cybersecurity Awareness Programme Kit](https://brivellis.com/open-grc-index/cybersecurity-awareness-kit/) (House): Free template or kit. Templates to plan, run and evidence a security awareness programme, including a policy and a 12-month plan.
- [ISMS in Practice (free course)](https://brivellis.com/open-grc-index/isms-in-practice-course/) (House): Free course. 26 short lessons that build an information security management system step by step with the ISMS Starter Kit and a fictional company.
- [ISMS Starter Kit for ISO/IEC 27001:2022](https://brivellis.com/open-grc-index/isms-starter-kit-iso27001/) (House): Free template or kit. 13 files for an information security management system, built around one fictional company so you can see a completed example before writing your own.
- [NIST AI RMF to ISO/IEC 42001 crosswalk](https://brivellis.com/open-grc-index/nist-ai-rmf-iso42001-crosswalk/): Open dataset or mapping. Third-party crosswalk hosted by NIST that maps AI Risk Management Framework subcategories to ISO/IEC 42001 clause and control numbers (prepared against the final draft).
- [NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0](https://brivellis.com/open-grc-index/nist-csf-2/): Official guidance. The CSF 2.0 core, profiles, quick-start guides and informative references, published free by NIST.
- [OSCAL (Open Security Controls Assessment Language)](https://brivellis.com/open-grc-index/oscal/): Open dataset or mapping. Machine-readable formats (XML, JSON, YAML) for control catalogues, baselines, system security plans and assessment results.
- [Probo](https://brivellis.com/open-grc-index/probo/): Open-source tool. Self-hostable GRC platform covering risks, controls, vendors, data privacy, access reviews and audits, with a Statement of Applicability and a CLI.
- [Readiness Checklists](https://brivellis.com/open-grc-index/readiness-checklists/) (House): Free template or kit. Excel checklists to gauge readiness before an audit, one per framework.
- [Secure Controls Framework (SCF)](https://brivellis.com/open-grc-index/secure-controls-framework/): Open dataset or mapping. Meta-framework of controls mapped to more than 200 laws, regulations and frameworks, downloadable as Excel and OSCAL JSON.
- [SMS in Practice (free course)](https://brivellis.com/open-grc-index/sms-in-practice-course/) (House): Free course. 26 short lessons that implement a service management system step by step with the SMS Starter Kit.
- [SMS Starter Kit for ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018](https://brivellis.com/open-grc-index/sms-starter-kit-iso20000/) (House): Free template or kit. 17 templates and worked examples for a service management system, from a scope statement to a workbook with a service catalogue.
